title: Nonhomeomorphic closed aspherical four-manifolds

result.label: Nonhomeomorphic closed aspherical four-manifolds
result.statement: Constructs closed connected aspherical topological four-manifolds that are homotopy equivalent but not homeomorphic, with a common word-hyperbolic fundamental group. This disproves even the homeomorphism-existence formulation of the Borel conjecture in dimension four.
